answer: The cornerstone is Stone carver granite block proof hewn at the carving yard. Lay it as each granite block is a season of logged quarry readings plus a signed stone record, and the whole wall stands on real work. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 654 fakes pay 654 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. The prism tells you who issued it, the hollow tells you what it cost, and the karst tells you when it was earned. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
